title: SMRTnet predicts small molecules that bind RNA
summary: The January 2026 Nature Biotechnology abstract reports 40 small-molecule hits across ten disease-associated RNA targets, with nanomolar-to-micromolar binding. One predicted compound reduced MYC expression, inhibited proliferation and promoted apoptosis in three cancer cell lines. SMRTnet combines language models with convolutional and graph attention networks, using RNA secondary structure. These are laboratory results.
organization: Tsinghua University; Peking University; Southwest United Graduate School

evidence.unknown: Not assessed: full-paper validation rates and therapeutic performance.
evidence.ai_role: Multimodal deep learning predicted small molecule-RNA interactions.
